title: Mahmoud — Founder & Product Engineer | Kepler Dev

texts.text: MAHMOUD MOHAMED ATTIA · FOUNDER & PRODUCT ENGINEER
I’m the founder of Kepler Dev, based in the United Kingdom and
Cairo, Egypt, and working with teams across the GCC and beyond. I
bring product thinking and engineering together—from
understanding the workflow to designing, building, and delivering the
Teams across the GCC and worldwide
I have spent the last several years inside connected products — loyalty platforms,
payment workflows, operational dashboards, internal tools — and the same
pattern keeps appearing. The product is built; the workflow is not. People end up
bridging the gaps between systems that were never designed to work together.
Kepler Dev exists to address that directly: bring product thinking and engineering
to the same conversation, and stay accountable from discovery through delivery.
The work is small by design. Each engagement is one product, one founder-led
team, and a clear scope that holds.
